title: Add a user to FileVault
summary: Grant a specific user account permission to unlock the encrypted disk. This allows that user to access the Mac after a restart.

steps.explain: Add a user to the list of FileVault-enabled users. Replace <USERNAME> with the actual username.

placeholders.name: USERNAME
placeholders.description: The username of the account to add to FileVault.

steps.expect: Confirmation that the user has been added.

warnings: Ensure the user account exists and is active before adding them.

rollback.explain: The tldr page does not provide a command to remove a user. You may need to use System Settings > Security & Privacy > FileVault to remove users.
